scenes.heading: YOUR AGENT GETS A *MAP*
scenes.say: This one program maps your whole codebase, so your coding agent stops guessing.

scenes.heading: MEET *GRAPHICLE*
scenes.say: It is Graphicle, a code graph and memory for coding agents, in a single Rust program.

scenes.heading: WHAT IT *BUILDS*
scenes.say: It builds a map of your code, remembers your docs and decisions, and answers with the exact files and lines.

scenes.heading: NATIVE *SPEED*
scenes.label: their test vs Graphify · 13 codebases
scenes.say: In their own tests it indexed code up to twenty-two times faster than Graphify, across thirteen codebases.

scenes.heading: TWO *COMMANDS*
scenes.say: Install it with Homebrew, run setup in your repo, and it connects the agents it finds.

scenes.heading: BEFORE YOU *INSTALL*
scenes.say: The catches: it is version zero point one, days old, and the Windows build is an unsigned preview. But there is no account, no key, no telemetry, and it is Apache two.
Want your agent to cite its sources? Comment GRAPH and I will pin the repo.

youtube.description:
Graphicle is a single Rust program (Apache-2.0) that maps your codebase into a code graph, remembers docs, decisions and past agent sessions, and serves cited excerpts with exact files and lines to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client. Local-first: no account, no API key, no telemetry. Vendor tests report up to 22.7x faster indexing than Graphify (pre-release builds). Catches: v0.1, days old; Windows preview is unsigned.
Source: https://github.com/Graphicle-AI/graphicle
